verdict.rationale: Docs confirm dedicated importers for Notion (with database/formula preservation into Bases), Evernote, Airtable, and OneNote, and Obsidian's native format is plain Markdown so switching from Markdown-based tools is trivial; community evidence also confirms a successful Roam-to-Obsidian migration. However, there's no explicit documentation of a Roam-specific importer or detailed guarantees about link/attachment fidelity during import, and community discussion focuses more on general satisfaction than verifying structural integrity post-import. Missing for 10: dedicated Roam importer docs, explicit attachment-preservation guarantees, and independent hands-on verification of link/structure fidelity across all four sources.
